physics-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-07.material: Sida laga arko Dhulka, xiddig ayaa $6$ sano-iftiin fog. Maraakiib ayaa ka dhaqaaqday Dhulka xagga xiddigga xawaare joogto ah oo $0.6c$ wuxuuna gaadhay xiddigga. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, waqtiga duulimaadka ee uu cabbiro indha-sidaha Dhulka iyo waqtiga duulimaadka ee uu cabbiro saacadda maraakiibta? (U qaado xawaaraha iftiinka $c$ inuu yahay $1$ sano-iftiin halkii sano.)
physics-killer-07.thinking.0: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Sida laga arko Dhulka, xiddig ayaa $6$ sano-iftiin fog. Maraakiib ayaa ka dhaqaaqday Dhulka xagga xiddigga xawaare joogto ah oo $0.6c$ wuxuuna gaadhay xiddigga. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, waqtiga duulimaadka ee uu cabbiro indha-sidaha Dhulka iyo waqtiga duulimaadka ee uu cabbiro saacadda maraakiibta? (U qaado xawaaraha iftiinka $c$ inuu yahay $1$ sano-iftiin halkii sano.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Indha-sidaha Dhulka: $\\Delta t=\\dfrac{6\\text{ sano-iftiin}}{0.6c}=10$ sano. $\\gamma=1/\\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Saacadda maraakiibtu way joogtaa bilowga iyo gaadhista labadaba, sidaas darteed waxay cabbirtaa waqtiga ugu habboon: $\\Delta t_0=\\Delta t/\\gamma=10/1.25=8$ sano. Isku dhufashadu waxay bixisaa $12.5$ sano (doodda 3), u qaybinta $\\gamma^2$ waxay bixisaa $6.4$ sano (doodda 1), isweydaarsiga labada qiimood waxay bixisaa doodda 4. (Qaab-dhismeedka maraakiibta, masaafadu waxay u yaraataa $6/1.25=4.8$ sano-iftiin, $4.8/0.6=8$ sano, waana isku waafaqsan yahay.)
physics-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
